note: UI Styles UI Patterns provides one UI Patterns Source plugin, ui_styles_attributes (AttributesStyles, prop_types ['attributes']), discovered by plugin.manager.ui_patterns_source. Its settings embed a ui_styles_styles selector (setting 'styles', a ui_styles.selected_mapping) plus an 'extra' HTML attributes field; getPropValue() merges selected+extra classes into the attributes class array. Schema ui_patterns_source.ui_styles_attributes. Requires ui_patterns + ui_styles. No route/permission/settings page. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the live ui_patterns source registry.

evals.prompt: How does UI Styles integrate with UI Patterns? Name the UI Patterns source plugin it provides and the prop type it targets.
evals.expected_output: It provides a UI Patterns Source plugin with id ui_styles_attributes (AttributesStyles) that targets props of type 'attributes', letting you fill a component's attributes prop with UI Styles classes.

evals.prompt: When configuring the UI Styles source on a UI Patterns component's attributes prop, what two inputs does it offer and what config keys store them?
evals.expected_output: It offers the standard ui_styles_styles selector (stored under the 'styles' setting, a {selected, extra} mapping) and an 'Extra HTML attributes' field (stored under 'extra'). Schema type ui_patterns_source.ui_styles_attributes.

evals.prompt: In UI Styles UI Patterns, how do the selected styles end up on the component's markup?
evals.expected_output: getPropValue() merges the selected style option classes and the extra classes, de-duplicates them, and returns an attributes mapping whose 'class' array carries them; the component renders those attributes on the prop's element.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the UI Styles / UI Patterns integration is active. Inspect the live UI Patterns source plugin registry and give the id of the source that exposes UI Styles and the prop type it targets.
evals.expected_output: Source id ui_styles_attributes, prop type 'attributes'. Confirm with \Drupal::service('plugin.manager.ui_patterns_source')->getDefinition('ui_styles_attributes').

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, make the UI Styles source (ui_styles_attributes) available to UI Patterns by enabling the correct integration module. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the ui_styles_ui_patterns module (drush en ui_styles_ui_patterns -y). Afterwards plugin.manager.ui_patterns_source->hasDefinition('ui_styles_attributes') is TRUE.
